footnote_text: The sale reported on this Form 4 represents shares sold by the Reporting Person to cover tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting and settlement of restricted stock units (RSUs). The Reporting Person has executed an instruction letter for the automatic sale of such sell to cover shares intended to satisfy the affirmative defense conditions of Rule 10b5-1. || Represents a weighted average sales price per share.
